messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: SERVICE capacity-exhaustion firing for inference-queue-prod — queue backlog >95% for 3m. PD incident INC-987654. @eng-oncall
pagerduty: page fired to rotation #eng-oncall — escalation in 5m if unacknowledged
Anya: acked — on it. will gather quick context. @Devon @Marta
Anya: looking at autoscaler logs, seeing repeated errors: 'failed to reconcile: quota exceeded' and provider API 429 throttles
Anya: metrics snapshot -> queue depth: 180k (baseline ~2k), provision latency p95 78s, pod create errors ~120/min in last 5m. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/boards/queue-backlog
Marta: confirming customer-facing spike: 503s up ~6% in us-west; a handful of PLG bots are timing out. support ticket #SUP-1821 opened
Devon: can we buy time with a manual scale? try: `kubectl scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=60 -n prod`
Anya: running manual scale now
DeployBot: manual scale triggered: deployment/inference-worker => replicas=60 (by Anya) — rollout started
Kai: autoscaler controller heartbeat shows 0/3 successful reconciles; controller logs:
```
E0618 14:12:05 autoscaler.go:312] reconcile error: provider API throttled: 429 Too Many Requests
E0618 14:12:07 autoscaler.go:320] reconcile backoff 30s
```
Anya: cloud provider quota shows no spare capacity in us-west-2 for our GPU instance family; spot pool exhausted
Devon: Marta, can you open a quota request to cloud support? if that will take too long we should enable fallback routing to a smaller model variant for non-SLA traffic
Marta: opening cloud quota request now. also enabling runtime routing fallback to 'model-compact-v1' for non-SLA customers to reduce throughput
Anya: applying fallback policy via runtime API (quick runbook step):
```
POST /v1/routing/policies/apply
{
  'policy': 'fallback-model-compact',
  'scope': 'prod',
  'target': 'non-sla'
}
```
Anya: fallback applied. observing immediate reduction in token throughput from heavy tenants
Anya: backlog decreasing — queue depth down ~40% after manual scale + fallback; latency p95 down to ~2.1s from 6.3s. still seeing some errors, monitoring
Devon: long-term we need autoscaler to handle provider throttles (fall back to other instance families / regions) — raising infra followup
Kai: autoscaler config is currently pinned to g4dn family. I'll open a PR to allow fallback to g5 or CPU-backed variants when GPU quota is low: https://git.redwood/internal/pr/4444
Anya: handing active monitoring to Devon for the next 45m while I push the quota request and coordinate with cloud support. documented steps in runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/queue-exhaustion
Devon: taking over. will keep PD incident open. if queue >20k or errors >5% after 15m I'll escalate to infra pager
pagerduty: INC-987654 acknowledged by Anya at 2024-06-18T14:13:02Z
incident-bot: update: manual scale + fallback applied, monitoring for stabilization. ETA 15m
Marta: quota request submitted — cloud ticket TICKET-555, expected response 30-45m. added support contact to the ticket
Anya: quick postmortem notes: autoscaler failed to fallback under provider API throttling; add preflight quota checks and region-fallback to runbook
Devon: leaving pinned commands and runbook snippet. revert fallback when capacity healthy with:
```
POST /v1/routing/policies/revert
{ 'policy': 'fallback-model-compact', 'scope': 'prod' }
```
Anya: will write the blameless postmortem and timeline. thanks team :heavy_check_mark:
Marta: +1
Kai: 👍
